prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite animation sheet for a fantasy RPG. Reference image supplies ONLY exact character identity, palette, costume and weapons for mage; do not copy its attack/idle poses. Create EIGHT DIFFERENT sequential RUNNING frames in EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows, equal cells, order left to right then next row. Landscape 1536x1024. Real transparent RGBA background with absolutely no floor shadows, labels, grid lines, text, backgrounds, effects or motion trails. One entire same-sized character per cell, centered with generous transparent gutters; no overlaps, clipping or extra characters. All frames face RIGHT, side / slight three-quarter view, carrying the reference weapon or shield naturally while jogging. Human running biomechanics are crucial: frame1 left leg reaches forward/right leg back, right arm forward/left arm back; frame2 weight on left foot, right knee advances; frame3 right knee drives forward and left leg pushes behind; frame4 airborne transition; frame5 opposite contact, right leg forward/left leg back, left arm forward/right arm back; frame6 weight on right foot,left knee advances; frame7 left knee drives forward/right leg pushes behind; frame8 airborne transition back to frame1. Make left/right legs distinguishable by shading so this is actual alternating stride, not eight similar static poses or whole-body translation. Clearly visible bent knees, lifted heels and alternating boots even for robed mage/cleric: robe split opens with stride. Arms swing in opposition with elbows bent, hands hold weapon/shield continuously, heavy gear restricts amplitude naturally. Cape, hair and cloth follow stride in a looping flutter. Keep head/torso volume and costume consistent, no attack poses. Match detailed crisp pixel-art sprite style of reference, sized to remain readable in 128px game frames.
